### 
Aadhaar Lock/Unlock
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
What is Aadhaar (UID) Lock & Unlock?
For an Aadhaar number holder, security and privacy of personal data is always a primary concern. To strengthen the security of his/her Aadhaar number and to provide control to the Aadhaar number holder, UIDAI provide a mechanism of locking and unlocking Aadhaar number (UID).
Aadhaar number holder can lock his or her Aadhaar (UID) via UIDAI website ([www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in](https://www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in)).
By doing this Aadhaar number holder cannot perform any sort of Authentication using UID, UID Token & VID for Biometrics, Demographic & OTP modality
If Aadhaar number holder wants to unlock UID he/she can do so by using latest VID, through UIDAI website.  
After unlocking Aadhaar (UID), Aadhaar number holder can perform authentication using UID, UID Token & VID.
How can Aadhaar number holder Lock UID?
How can Aadhaar number holder Unlock UID ?
For Unlocking UID Aadhaar number holder should have latest 16 digit VID and if Aadhaar number holder forgot 16 digit VID he can retrieve latest VID through SMS services
RVID Space last 4 or 8 digit of UID. SMS to 1947. Ex- RVID 1234
To unlock UID, Aadhaar number holder may visit UIDAI website (<https://myaadhaarbeta.uidai.gov.in/lock-unlock-aadhaar/en>), select Unlock radio button, Enter Latest VID and security Code and click on send OTP or select TOTP and click on Submit. Your UID will be unlocked successfully.
I forgot my VID. How can I get it after locking UID?
After Locking UID if Aadhaar number holder forgot VID, Aadhaar number holder can make use of SMS service to Retrieve 16 digit VID. Aadhaar number holder will receive VID on his/her register mobile number. Send SMS to 1947 from Aadhaar Register mobile number, RVID Space last 4 or 8 digit of UID. Ex:- RVID 1234
